speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing the decreased vision and black spots in your right eye? Also, have you noticed any pain, flashes of light, or a curtain-like shadow over your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of AIDS and recent fungal esophagitis, these symptoms suggest a possible ocular fungal infection or retinal issue. Have you noticed any floaters that seem to be increasing in number, or any sudden changes in your peripheral vision?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Decreased vision and black spots in the right eye. I also have No pain, Left eye is asymptomatic.

speaker: Doctor
text: You have a history of AIDS and Kaposi's sarcoma; has your current CD4 count or viral load been checked recently? Given your symptoms, I need to check your retina immediately, so REQUEST TEST: Dilated Fundus Examination.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CD4 T-lymphocyte count is critically low at 36/mm3. Dilated Fundus Examination reveals granular yellow-white opacities around the retinal vessels and multiple areas of dot-blot hemorrhages in the right eye, consistent with Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. General examination confirms cervical lymphadenopathy and multiple violaceous plaques over the trunk and extremities consistent with Kaposi's sarcoma. Vital signs show afebrile status (37°C), stable blood pressure (110/70 mmHg), and heart rate of 89/min. BMI is 15.6 kg/m2, indicating significant underweight status.

speaker: Doctor
text: The dilated fundus examination showing granular yellow-white opacities and dot-blot hemorrhages, combined with your critically low CD4 count, confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis.
